verdict.rationale: The Gemini API is itself a documented public API. First-party docs cover a REST API reachable in a single call, official GenAI SDKs for Python, JS/TS, Go and Java, and OpenAI-library compatibility. They also cover function calling, structured JSON output, Batch and Live APIs, and a maintained changelog, deprecations page and pinnable model versions. Missing for 10: a machine-readable API description for agents, since probes found no OpenAPI/Swagger spec at the candidate paths and llms.txt returns 404.
